WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH q AS (
 SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_quarter=3 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
),
src AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) ids
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN q ON q.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM src) dup_groups,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN q ON q.calendar_date=f.sale_date) lines,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN q ON q.calendar_date=f.sale_date) distinct_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN q ON q.calendar_date=r.return_date) rets,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN q ON q.calendar_date=r.return_date) distinct_rets

WITH nl AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, sum(n.net_sales) m FROM nl n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.store_id, sum(c.net_sales) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND c.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT coalesce(mine.fiscal_year,ctl.fiscal_year) fy, coalesce(mine.store_id,ctl.store_id) store_id, m, c, round(coalesce(m,0)-coalesce(c,0),2) diff
FROM mine FULL JOIN ctl ON mine.fiscal_year=ctl.fiscal_year AND mine.store_id=ctl.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m,0)-coalesce(c,0))>1 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.open_date, cs.close_date,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN d.fiscal_week END) ly_weeks,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN d.fiscal_week END) ty_weeks,
  max(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN c.business_date END) last_sale,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN c.net_sales END)) ly, round(sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN c.net_sales END)) ty
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=c.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND c.store_id<900 AND c.net_sales_before_returns>0
GROUP BY ALL HAVING ly_weeks<>13 OR ty_weeks<>13 OR cs.open_date IS NOT NULL OR cs.close_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
